prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object nearby, pick up object and check it. If no object nearby, move towards it. Finally, scan area for objects. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectNearby    /> <Action ID = MoveTowardsObject    /> <Condition ID = IsPathClear    /> <Action ID = ScanForObjects    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectNearby? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObject
	END
